This test verifies various behaviors of function extraction when every return statement in the extracted block is an error handling return.

-- go.mod --
module mod.test/extract

go 1.18

-- a.go --
package err_handling

import "encoding/json"

func FuncReturnError() error {
	_, err := json.Marshal(0) //@codeaction("_", "refactor.extract.function", end=end, result=a)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	} //@loc(end, "}")
	return err
}

-- @a/a.go --
package err_handling

import "encoding/json"

func FuncReturnError() error {
	err, err1 := newFunction()
	if err1 != nil {
		return err1
	} //@loc(end, "}")
	return err
}

func newFunction() (error, error) {
	_, err := json.Marshal(0) //@codeaction("_", "refactor.extract.function", end=end, result=a)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return err, nil
}

-- b.go --
package err_handling

import "encoding/json"

func FuncReturnNil() error {
	_, err := json.Marshal(0) //@codeaction("_", "refactor.extract.function", end=end2, result=b)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	} //@loc(end2, "}")
	return nil
}

-- @b/b.go --
package err_handling

import "encoding/json"

func FuncReturnNil() error {
	err := newFunction()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	} //@loc(end2, "}")
	return nil
}

func newFunction() error {
	_, err := json.Marshal(0) //@codeaction("_", "refactor.extract.function", end=end2, result=b)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}
